## Validation

Commands run and their results:

- [ ] This PR changes at most five article files, or is a separate infrastructure/review PR.
- [ ] I checked the entire source and did not copy a modern Korean or official English translation.
- [ ] I preserved source fingerprints and did not add a review badge or self-approval.

For software-only PRs, mark translation items “not applicable” and explain relevant tests. Automated checks and a merge do not certify translation accuracy.
